title: EEG dataset on consumer responses to extreme versus traditional marketing videos
description: EEG recordings from ten participants who viewed six marketing videos from three companies (Red Bull, GoPro, Columbia Sportswear). The videos were either traditional product-focused advertisements or 'extreme' authentic documentary-style content. The dataset supports research on neural correlates of consumer responses to different marketing video styles.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a 14-channel EMOTIV EPOC X headset while ten participants watched six marketing video stimuli, grouped as traditional versus extreme.
